answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy requires each identity to generate original reasoning that flows like a river under unique challenge seeds. A jury grades for novelty and rejects copies. Attackers must create distinct high-quality texts for every fake identity, multiplying inference costs linearly. Cryptographic anchors freeze history so zephyrs of false data cannot rewrite it. The trellis of peer attestations supports only genuine work. Attacker cost is sustained compute and creativity per identity per epoch.
